description: Synthetic experiment applying a pattern-specific lateral score to streaming-PCA (crystallized) patterns on a 13x12 grid, with a held-out frozen gate comparing overlap-only against a combined overlap+lateral score under seam-shift and row-slip corruption. Mun Seok Lee is cited as inspiration only for the Digital to Wave paradigm; he wrote no line of this package. Classical toy only; no biology, medical, quantum-hardware, brain, or consciousness claim.
